I have measured the diameter of four bacterial colonies. The results were as follows: 2.2mmm, 1.6mm, 3.3mm, 4.0mm. I want to calculate the total  diameter of these colonies.
```{r}
total_colony_diameter <- sum(2.2, 1.6, 3.3, 4.0)
print(total_colony_diameter)

```
